name: factory
description: A software factory: /factory <feature> writes a spec, has you approve its plan (in goal-run when it's installed), builds it on a branch, runs the checks and parallel reviews, and has an approver agent decide; you then press Open PR and Claude opens it. Its pane draws where the run is

checks.title: Check commands
checks.description: Commands the factory runs after each build, separated by ; (no shell), e.g. npm test; npm run lint. Empty uses .factory/checks.json, else detects them (node, python, go, cargo, make, maven/gradle, dotnet; root, one level down, touched folders) plus allowlisted commands in the spec acceptance criteria

maxRounds.title: Review rounds
maxRounds.description: How many times reviewers may send the builder back before the approver decides

setup.title: Setup command
setup.description: Commands that install the dependencies in a run's fresh worktree before its first checks, separated by ; (no shell), e.g. npm ci. Empty uses the lockfile (npm ci, pnpm or yarn install) when node_modules is missing

autoPr.title: Open the PR without asking
autoPr.description: on: the PR is opened as soon as the approver agent approves. off: the run waits for you to press Open PR

models.title: Models by feature size
models.description: auto: the spec-writer judges the feature small, medium or large, and a large one runs the builder on opus (sonnet otherwise). fixed: sonnet for the spec-writer, builder and code reviewer, opus for the security reviewer and approver, whatever the size

skills.title: Skills per role
skills.description: Skills a role loads before its job, in place of the factory's own (factory:spec-writer, factory:builder, factory:security-reviewer, factory:code-reviewer, factory:approver), as role=skill,skill; role=skill (roles: spec, builder, security, code, approver); role=none loads none. E.g. spec=spec-pack; security=security. Empty: every role loads the factory's own skill
